text:
Alex C: FYI: our quantized Llama3Q long-seq runs show intermittent token dropouts around ~2k tokens on runtime v2.18.x. Repro on canary. Proposing temporary pin of runtime to v2.17.4 while we root-cause. :warning:
Priya N: ugh, thanks for flagging. Is this only with the quantized build or also full FP?
Alex C: only on Q4 quantized profiles so far. full-FP and float16 look fine.
Marco D: can we confirm which kernel selection path triggers it? guessing the newer fused attention kernel.
Alex C: logs point to a kernel selection flip for long-seq kvcache cleanup. attaching minimal repro snippet:
```
# repro: generate long prompt ~2200 tokens
client.generate(model="llama3q-7b-q4", max_tokens=2300)
# result: generation truncates with repeated "" token sequence
```
Jenna R: QA ran a quick canary test on dedicated pool: 3/5 runs failed with truncation at ~2050 tokens.
Li W: What's the proposed action? pin runtime here means service-wide impact?
Alex C: short plan: 1) temp pin runtime to v2.17.4 for hosted & dedicated canaries, 2) open rollback/monitor window for 24h, 3) eng-ml to bisect and push patch for kernel selection logic.
Priya N: timeline? we should avoid customer-facing regressions during APAC peak.
Alex C: propose change window in 2h (low APAC) and keep pin for 24h until patch validated.
deploy-bot: Received request to apply runtime pin. Creating a pin record now. Command executed:
```
/deploy pin runtime v2.17.4 --scope hosted,dedicated --until 2026-03-22T18:00:00Z --reason "temp pin for long-seq quantized dropout"
```
Status: pin applied (id: pin-2109876543). Rolling back pending new runtime rollouts for pinned targets.
Marco D: tagging SDK folks: this could affect runtime-client negotiation? @Priya N can you confirm client compatibility?
Priya N: SDK is compatible with v2.17.4. If we later unpin to v2.18.x, SDK minor bump might be needed depending on auth handshake change (low risk).
Jenna R: QA quick checklist for pin window:
- smoke gen on canary models (q4) :white_check_mark:
- long-seq regression tests (>= 5 runs) :in_progress:
- alerting on spike in 5xx or truncation tokens :white_check_mark:
Li W: rollback plan if pin causes unexpected issues: immediate unpin + fallback to v2.17.3 and open incident channel. Who's owner?
Alex C: I'll own rollback steps and incident channel triage. Marco will run bisect and a kernel toggle PR. Jenna will lead QA validation.
Priya N: can deploy-bot annotate the pin with the runbook link and incident severity if escalation needed?
deploy-bot: Pin record updated. Metadata: owners=["Alex C","Marco D"], runbook=https://internal/redwood/runbooks/quant-longseq-pin, severity=medium. :white_check_mark:
Jenna R: initial QA results posted to the runbook page. 4/6 reproductions so far, logging details there.
Marco D: starting bisect now. If we confirm fused-attn kernel flip is culprit, patch should be small (kernel selection guard + opt-out flag). ETA ~6-12h for candidate.
Li W: thanks — please post a final sign-off before unpin. If anything customer-impacting appears, we'll escalate to oncall and extend pin.
Alex C: noted. will update here with candidate builds and QA pass. thanks all. :thumbsup:
